init-auth0.title: initAuth0
init-auth0.description: Initializes the Auth0 SDK. Call this once and export the returned helpers.

parameters.name: params
parameters.description: SDK configuration. Reads from environment variables if not provided.

returns.description: Object containing getSession, getAccessToken, withApiAuthRequired, withPageAuthRequired.

get-session.title: getSession
get-session.description: Returns the session for the current request, or null if not authenticated.
get-session.signature: getSession(req: IncomingMessage, res: ServerResponse): Promise<Session | null>

returns.description: The session, or null if the user is not logged in.

get-access-token.title: getAccessToken
get-access-token.description: Returns the access token for the current user, refreshing it if expired.
get-access-token.signature: getAccessToken(req: IncomingMessage, res: ServerResponse, options?: GetAccessTokenOptions): Promise<GetAccessTokenResult>

returns.description: Object containing the access token string.

with-api-auth-required.title: withApiAuthRequired
with-api-auth-required.description: Wraps an API route to require authentication. Returns 401 for unauthenticated requests.

parameters.name: handler
parameters.description: The API route handler to protect.

with-page-auth-required.title: withPageAuthRequired
with-page-auth-required.description: Protects a page from unauthenticated access using getServerSideProps.
